name: Cloaked
description_en:
Cloaked combines a credential vault with generated email addresses and phone numbers, letting a person give each service a different contact identity. Data removal, call protection and other privacy services surround that identity workflow; it is broader than a conventional password manager.

Its help center currently limits availability to the United States and Canada. Evaluate communication delivery and account recovery as carefully as autofill: an alias that replaces your usual contact details can become the recovery destination for an important external account.
description_zh:
Cloaked 将凭据保险库与生成的邮箱、电话号码结合，让不同服务收到不同的联系身份。数据移除、来电保护等隐私服务围绕这一身份流程展开，范围超出传统密码管理器。

帮助中心目前注明仅在美国、加拿大提供。评估时应像核对填充一样核对通信送达和账户恢复：替代真实联系资料的别名，可能成为重要外部账户的恢复地址。

sections.title_en: Build a reusable identity for a service
sections.title_zh: 为服务创建可复用身份
sections.en:
An identity can contain a phone number, email address, username and password. In the dashboard, create and name an identity, generate the required fields and save the login in the extension. The help article distinguishes account forwarding destinations from the forwarding setting on each identity. Email and texts remain accessible inside Cloaked with forwarding off; a phone call needs forwarding to ring a personal phone.

For a test signup, verify email delivery, then sign out and test autofill. Muting only silences notifications: it does not block senders. Replacing a detail immediately disables the old detail, although the guide allows restoration from Trash within 30 days. Update external recovery settings before replacing an address or number.
sections.zh:
身份可包含电话号码、邮箱、用户名和密码。在控制台中新建并命名身份，生成需要的字段，再通过扩展保存登录。帮助文章区分账户转发目的地与每个身份的转发设置。关闭转发后，邮件和短信仍能在 Cloaked 内查看；电话要响到个人手机则需要转发。

可用测试注册核对收信，再退出并验证填充。静音只关闭通知，不会阻止发送者。替换字段会立即停用旧字段，但指南允许在 30 天内从垃圾箱恢复。替换地址或号码前应更新外部账户的恢复设置。

sections.title_en: Account access and encrypted data recovery differ
sections.title_zh: 账户访问与加密数据恢复不同
sections.en:
The recovery guide describes OTP, master-password and passkey sign-in. OTP accounts depend on control of the registered phone number. For master-password accounts, the recovery key can restore full access; support cannot recover the password or key. A verified recovery address may allow basic mode while encrypted data stays locked.

A final account reset retains generated addresses and numbers but loses stored passwords, usernames, messages, identity details and voicemail. That is not recovery of the old vault. Save the recovery key outside the account before migrating valuable credentials, and validate which sign-in method the account actually uses.
sections.zh:
恢复指南列出 OTP、主密码和 passkey 登录。OTP 账户依赖对注册号码的控制。主密码账户可用恢复密钥恢复完整访问，支持无法找回密码或密钥。已验证的恢复地址可能允许进入基本模式，但加密数据仍锁定。

最终重置账户会保留生成的地址和号码，却丢失已存密码、用户名、消息、身份详情和语音留言。这并非恢复旧保险库。迁移重要凭据前应在账户外保存恢复密钥，并核对实际登录方式。

sections.title_en: Read billed totals and rollout labels
sections.title_zh: 核对实收金额和推出状态
sections.en:
The pricing page lists monthly Individual, Couple and Family plans at USD 14.99, 19.99 and 29.99; annual billed totals are USD 119.99, 174.99 and 299.99. Couple covers two people and Family four. The annual Couple monthly-equivalent label does not arithmetically match its billed total, so use the total and confirm checkout.

The same page labels Cloaked Pay invite-only and Family Sharing coming soon, despite selling a Family subscription. Buying several seats therefore does not establish that every sharing feature is available. Insurance eligibility, excluded uses and enterprise terms require their own policy review. This research did not test the vault, removal service, VPN or any recovery procedure.
sections.zh:
价格页列个人、双人、家庭月付分别为 14.99、19.99、29.99 美元；年付实收分别为 119.99、174.99、299.99 美元。双人覆盖两人，家庭覆盖四人。双人年付的月均标签与实收总额算术不一致，应以总额核对结账。

同页将 Cloaked Pay 标为邀请制、Family Sharing 标为即将推出，同时销售家庭订阅。购买多个席位并不能证明全部共享功能已开放。保险资格、排除用途及企业条款需另查政策。本文未测试保险库、移除服务、VPN 或恢复过程。
